accessDeniedBody: Tenant settings are visible only to Tenant Owner or Security Admin. Ask one of them to change this, or to grant you one of those roles from the Users page.

security.title: Security
security.description: Rate limits and general security/data-handling posture.
security.rateLimitDescription: Read-only, deployment-wide, not adjustable per tenant.
security.outboundTelemetryDescription: Whether this tenant's operational telemetry may leave this deployment's own infrastructure.
security.cloudStorageDescription: Whether this tenant may use cloud object storage (e.g. for evidence-bundle exports) rather than local/on-prem storage only.

sso.title: SSO
sso.description: Read-only details of this tenant's sign-in realm.
sso.notProvisioned: This tenant has no provisioned realm yet.
sso.federationUnavailableTitle: SSO federation: not available in this release
sso.federationUnavailableBody: Connecting your organisation's identity provider to Manar sign-in is not supported or tested in this release. Do not configure federation on this realm; users sign in with accounts held in the realm below.

residency.title: Data residency
residency.description: Where this tenant's data is required to stay, and what that implies for outbound AI/telemetry/storage reachability.
residency.warning: One of the most consequential settings in this console: it governs whether this tenant's data can leave its required jurisdiction at all, including via AI-advisory calls.

UAE.label: UAE
UAE.description: Data must stay within the UAE. The Security and AI pages' individual allow-external flags still govern outbound telemetry/storage/AI reachability separately.

CUSTOM_REGION.label: Custom region
CUSTOM_REGION.description: Data must stay within a specific, deployment-configured region other than the UAE default.

AIR_GAPPED.label: Air-gapped
AIR_GAPPED.description: No outbound network reachability at all is assumed. Every allow-external flag on the Security and AI pages should also be off in this mode. This console does not toggle them for you automatically.

residency.confirmDescription: Changing residency to "{to}" takes effect immediately. Review what that value means above before confirming. This is not a cosmetic setting.

ai.title: AI settings
ai.description: Which AI provider this deployment is configured to use, and whether this tenant's AI-advisory requests may reach it.
ai.providerScopeNote: Deployment-wide: the same provider serves every tenant on this deployment; this isn't a per-tenant choice.
ai.allowExternalAiDescription: Whether this tenant's AI-advisory-eligible requests may reach an external provider. Takes effect immediately: the very next eligible request respects this value, with no caching in between.
ai.allowExternalAiNoEffectNote: The currently configured provider ({provider}) is not external, so this flag currently has no effect. It only matters if this deployment is later switched to an external provider.
